title: docs(client): record Axios reachability and stop before removal
intent: Adjudicate the 20 production Axios importers and stop before dependency removal. Seven rows are UNRESOLVED, so Axios stays a direct dependency (^1.20.0 at base 93c69e26; ^1.21.0 on main after the owner merged PR #470 as c6542957, which this increment did not modify), and no importer is rewritten or deleted.
behavior_change: CI only. core_ci.yml runs scripts/ci/test_client_axios_reachability.py. No client runtime, route, or dependency change.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Adds an evidence-only reachability scanner, inventory tests, the 20-row disposition record, and a CI pin so those tests run. Does not change client source, package.json, or the lockfile.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The production bundle contains no Axios, and that fact is not a deletion decision. The record is the stop: unresolved risk-dashboard and rosette-compare copies block retirement, and dormant sole clients of live routes stay in the tree.

commands_run: npm run build in packages/client, twice; dist manifests byte-identical; 199 files, 4117422 bytes; no axios string in dist
vue-tsc: 87 errors, ceiling 87, PASS. ESLint: 34 errors and 6979 warnings, ceilings hold, PASS. npm test: 803 passed, 17 todo, 1 file skipped
